source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 19ης Νοεμβρίου — «Όσιος Σίμων»

attestations.note: The life page `https://www.saint.gr/2912/saint.aspx` heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 19 Νοεμβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. The page says where the commemoration comes from and does not overstate it: «Άγνωστος στους Συναξαριστές και στα Μηναία. Η μνήμη του υπάρχει στον Παρισινό Κώδικα 1621 (13ος αιώνας μ.Χ.)», and the narrative it prints is a quotation it credits to S. Eustratiades's Hagiology, page 425. This is a statement about the entry's own sources and not the sentence «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη η ύπαρξη του Αγίου», which is not on the page, and there is no asterisk. None of the corpus's nine other Simon folders is proposed as this man: they are kept on other days and none is a Calabrian. The thirteenth-century codex dates the commemoration and not the man, so no `dates` object is proposed. No hymn.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue as printed by pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (2 October 2026).
